About Me

I am a passionate Java Full Stack Developer based in Bengaluru, India, specializing in building high-performance backend systems, RESTful APIs, and responsive web applications.

Graduated with a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering from Don Bosco Institute of Technology, I bring strong hands-on expertise in Core Java, Advanced Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Hibernate ORM, JPA, and MySQL.

Through my internship at JSpiders and real-world project developments (such as HirePulse Job Portal and NexusTech E-Commerce), I have built production-ready Spring Boot applications with JWT authentication, Spring Security, and automated deployment pipelines using Docker, Jenkins, and Git Workflows.
